record.question: Under Rule 30, half pay leave may be commuted without production of a medical certificate during the entire service up to 180 days where it is utilized for:
options: private affairs certified by the Head of Office.
joining a training programme conducted by any private institution.
an approved course of study certified to be in the public interest by the leave sanctioning authority.
